verdict.rationale: Whether the source is available under an open license is a fair question for an email marketing platform, since open-source alternatives exist in this category, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows EmailOctopus publishes its source or uses an open license. The pack covers only a proprietary hosted service with an API, an editor and paid plans.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
